items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: And another well known musician, a brass man, a trombone man and writer, J.J. Johnson.

ctx.x: Well you know, Marv was the music director for a time for the Lucy Show.
Yeah. And another well known musician, a brass man, a trombone man and writer, J.J. Johnson. He finally got straightened.
Yeah; we worked with Basie together, 1945. J.J. is all straight, I think he wrote the music for Shaft.
